analysis_result.analysis: The model failed at the foundational perception step by misidentifying the visible face colors and orientations of the reference cube. This led to cascading grounding errors: it then incorrectly matched this misperceived cube to Option C, which does not align with the actual reference cube (which is Option A). The error stems from misreading the visual input rather than flawed logic or spatial reasoning — the model simply saw the wrong colors on the wrong faces.
